phase: Phase 15 — Candlestick + Price Action + Chart Structure Feature Research
verdict_reason: Phase 15 candlestick/price-action features did NOT demonstrate consistent out-of-sample improvement over Phase 12 baseline (Holdout ROC-AUC: 0.5015 vs 0.5021, Brier: 0.2495 vs 0.2498). Phase 12 Calibrated XGBoost v1.0 remains production prediction engine.
